description: List every script one scan captured, once per distinct content: whether and how it was obfuscated (tool and level), whether decoding or unpacking worked, and what became visible only after decoding (hosts, URLs, wallet addresses, threat-feed matches, messaging channels, WebAssembly). Each entry has the fingerprint_id of its full analysis. The level says how much effort went into hiding the code, not whether it is dangerous. scan_id is the UUID of a ScanMalware scan.

scan_id.description: UUID of a ScanMalware scan: the scan_id of a submission or of a search result.
